title: Saltkerns/Gullhaven opened five side quests in about 35 turns (Lost Fleet, Wreckers' Roost, Salt-Pan Hermit, Missing Nets, Passage Under the Pass) with no signal of which, if any, mattered to 'resting' that hollow versus pure flavor, making it hard to judge whether to keep pulling threads or move on.
